Messages.Author: Nac
Messages.Body:
Hi

Yesterday we had a discution about Karsh ADV and Veles Hunt. I know there are numerous instances in which this had been asked since the start but I'll do it again since I could not convince them they were still valid:

Can Karsh ADV play Veles Hunt from ash heap?

(On a side note, I understand why people get confused about it, other templates for searching cards with trait such as Fortschritt Library are worded in a very similar way)

Many thanks in advance

[Adv] Karsh
[ANI]
[CEL]
[FOR]
[POT]
[PRO]
Gangrel

Capacity: 10

Group: 3

Advanced, Camarilla: Karsh may play a Blood Hunt card from your hand or ash heap as a prince. He gets 3 additional votes in blood hunt referendums. He cannot block infernal vampires.
[MERGED] Imperator (3 votes): +1 intercept.

Veles' Hunt
Political Action

Gangrel
[3 Pool]
Blood hunt referendum.
Choose an ally or younger non-titled vampire controlled by your prey. Successful referendum means that minion is burned. If this referendum fails or is canceled, no more Veles' Hunts can be played this game.

Fortschritt Library
Master

Master.
Search your library for a Gehenna event card. Show it to all players and add it to your hand. Discard down to your hand size afterward. Only one Fortschritt Library may be played per game.

Messages.Author: Palamedes
Messages.Body:
Karsh can't play Veles' Hunt from the ash heap.

Karsh can play card with name "Blood Hunt" from ash heap.

Blood Hunt
[Action] Action
+1 stealth action. Requires a ready prince or justicar.
Put this card on a vampire who is not a prince, a justicar or an Inner Circle member. Any vampire controlled by another Methuselah may enter combat with this vampire as a +1 stealth  action.

Messages.Author: thelonius reloaded
Messages.Body:
Bernard, the Scourge

Gangrel

Capacity: 5

Group: 4

Camarilla: Bernard can call a blood hunt on a vampire of capacity 4 or less as a +1 stealth political action.

Artist(s): John Bridges

Set(s): KoT:V

So Bernard is calling a blood hunt exactly the same as the one after a diablerie.

Lurking in the underground of Bologna, Italy

Messages.Author: Palamedes
Messages.Body:
> thelonius wrote:
> So Bernard is calling a blood hunt exactly the same as the one after a diablerie.
>
I believe it is not the same, because Bernard's blood hunt is classic political action, where vampires can play cards to gain votes.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Palamedes wrote:
>
> > thelonius wrote:
> > So Bernard is calling a blood hunt exactly the same as the one after a diablerie.
> >
> I believe it is not the same, because Bernard's blood hunt is classic political action, where vampires can play cards to gain votes.
>
Correct. The effects are the same (a vampire is burned if the vote passes) but the context is different (diablerie blood hunts happen outside the action, whereas Bernard's blood hunt is a typical political action).
